| 3




Long Period Average (LPA) by 74%. Cumulative seasonal rainfall (01 Jan to 09 Feb 2025) is lower than LPA by 70%. Rainfall Forecast: 13th Feb – 19th Feb 2025 a) A fresh western disturbance is likely to impact the western Himalayan regions and adjoining plains from night of 18th Feb till 20th February with peak intensity on 19th and 20th February. b) Isolated to scattered light rainfall/snowfall activity likely over Jammu-Kashmir-Ladakh, Uttarakhand & Himachal Pradesh during 17th-22nd; Isolated light rainfall activity likely over West Rajasthan during 17th-19th; Punjab, Haryana on 19th & 20th; East Rajasthan on 18th &19th; West Uttar Pradesh on 20th February. c) With movement of this Western Disturbance further eastwards & a north-south Trough at lower levels: Thunderstorms accompanied with lightning & light rainfall likely over Gangetic West Bengal during 19th - 22nd; Odisha and Jharkhand during 19th -21st February. 20th Feb - 26th Feb, 2025 d) The Western disturbance will continue to impact western Himalayan regions and adjoining plains on 20th February and then it is likely to move eastwards and impact east and northeast India on 21- 23 February. Under its influence, e) light/moderate isolated to scattered rainfall/snowfall likely over the Western Himalayan Region during some/many days of the week.
| 4 f) Light/moderate isolated to scattered rainfall is likely over northeast India during some days of the week. g) Overall, rainfall is likely to be dry i.e. near normal over all the homogeneous regions of the country during the week.

chunks.heading: 2. TEMPERATURE: MIN & MAX
chunks.text:
Temperature Forecast 13th Feb – 19th Feb 2025 a) Gradual fall in minimum temperatures by 1-2℃ in East India during next 2 days and 1-3℃ in central India during next 24 hours and thereafter gradual rise by 2-3℃ and 2-4℃ in respective region during remaining part of the week. In East India, a decline of 3-5°C is likely over the next two days, followed by stable conditions. b) No significant change in minimum temperatures is expected over West India for the next three days, followed by a gradual rise of 2-3°C during the remaining part of the week. There is also no significant temperature variations rest of the country throughout the week. c) A gradual fall in maximum temperatures by 1-2°C is expected over Northwest India, except Uttar Pradesh, while Uttar Pradesh itself is likely to experience a drop of 2-4°C over the next two days, followed by a gradual rise of 2-3°C thereafter. No significant change in maximum temperatures is anticipated over West, Central, and East India for the next 2-3 days, with a gradual rise of 2-3°C expected thereafter. 20th Feb - 26th Feb, 2025 d) Minimum temperatures are likely to be between 12-14°C over many parts of plains of northwest India, 14-16°C over central India, 16-18°C over east India, 18-20°C over most parts of peninsular India, and between 20-22°C over coastal regions of south peninsular India during the week. e) Minimum temperatures are likely to be below normal by 2-4°C over many parts of east and adjoining east central & north Peninsular India and 1-2°C above normal over northwest India during the week. f) Maximum temperatures are likely be above normal by 1-2°C over many parts of northwest & east India during the week.

chunks.text:
